name: Aluminium electrolytic capacitor (radial)
description: Bulk capacitor for supply rails (servo / motor driver supply). Set params.uf and params.v_rated.
notes: Polarised: the stripe marks the - leg. Reversed or over-voltage electrolytics can burst.
Voltage rating must be above the highest rail voltage with margin (use at least 1.5 x: a 16 V cap on 12 V is too tight, use 25 V).
Typical uses: 100-470 uF across a driver VMOT, 470-1000 uF on a servo rail.
Size depends on value and voltage: check the can (100 uF 25 V is about 6.3 x 11 mm).
